units.name: Fortified Building
units.notes: Place a single small building anywhere in your deployment. It has alredy been fortified for defence amd gives Infantry units inside a 3+ Cover Save

unitComposition.name: Infantry Sniper Team concealed and deployed in Reinforced Cover.
Infantry Weapons Team with a MILAN ATGM deployed in a dug-out. The cover is lost of the unit moves.

units.name: Marked Minefield
units.notes: A single, marked mixed minefield (anti-tank and anti-personel mines).

units.name: Hidden Minefield
units.notes: A single, unmarked mixed minefield (anti-tank and anti-personel mines).

units.name: Hidden Claymore Anti-personnel Minefield
units.notes: A single, unmarked anti-personnel minefield . Note down on a sketch map where the centre of the claymore minefiled is.

units.name: Anti-tank Ditch
units.notes: Up to 10inches of ditch. The anti-tank ditch is impassable to all vehicles.

unitComposition.name: Infantry Weapons Team with a Blowpipe MANPAD in foxholes.
Infantry Weapons Team with a sGPMG deploued in a dug-out. The cover is lost if the unit moves..

units.name: Bridge Demolition
units.notes: A single bridge, anywhere on the table, has aleady been wired with a demolition charge. Before the start of the game write down which bridge has been wired. At teh start if any of his turns, the British player may detonate the bridge. Roll a dice. On a 2+ the bridge is destroyed. On a 1 teh demolition charge fails to go off.

units.name: Road Block
units.notes: Rubble, trees, wrecks, tank traps, etc. that block a single road anywhere in your deployment zone or no-mans land. The road is impassable at the road-block unless the road-block is destoryed.
